_comment: symbol(UPPER NSE/BSE) -> correct bare domain for img.logo.dev. Overrides the naive '<name>.com' guess stored in mc.companies.logo_url, which makes logo.dev serve the wrong/foreign brand. Domains are sourced from yfinance's `website` field (authoritative). Extend with scripts/build_logo_overrides.py or by hand. Keys must be UPPER; values are bare domains (no scheme, no www).
